name: Enforcer
description: The wall between the crew and the teeth.
long_description: When the horde hits the barricade, somebody has to be the barricade. Enforcers fight close, hit hard and do not step backwards, because behind them is everyone they know. Master the line to specialise: Mercenary or Veteran - and Mercenaries who master the dirty work may yet pick up a flamethrower.
